test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: T, U, V, W, X, Y, Z and A were eight family members sitting around a square table, facing the centre. Some of them were sitting at the corners, while some were sitting at the exact centre of the sides. Only one person was sitting between W and X. V was sitting fourth to the left of U. Only A was sitting between Z and X. Y was not sitting at any of the corner positions. X was sitting at one of the corners. V was sitting to the immediate let of Z. Which of the following family members was at one of the corner positions of the table
solution: **Given:** T, U, V, W, X, Y, Z and A were eight family members sitting around a square table, facing the centre. 1) Only one person was sitting between W and X. 2) V was sitting fourth to the left of U. 3) Only A was sitting between Z and X.
